media:group.media:description:
From technical accomplishments and feature improvements to the systems powering the ’verse, we're putting Technology in Focus in this episode of 10 From the Community.
Join us as we answer ten questions from the Star Citizen community about NPC behavior, social features, user interfaces, ground vehicles, bug fixes, and the ongoing work to make Star Citizen a more stable, connected, and immersive experience.
